content:
anya: Heads-up — nightly perf suite for dedicated pools shows a sharp throughput regression after the cublasLt bump landed in streak-ops (looks like cublasLt 2.14.0).

leo: saw that in CI dashboard, p50 tokens/sec down ~35% for int8-quant workloads :grimacing:

mohit: which tests specifically? smallbatch or long-seq?

anya: smallbatch (batch=1..4), seq_len=32 mostly. Hosted and Dedicated both affected but Dedicated more obvious. Example numbers from nightly compare:

perf-bot: baseline (pre-bump): avg throughput=1200 tok/s, p50=0.82ms
perf-bot: after bump: avg throughput=780 tok/s, p50=1.28ms

leo: that's consistent with a kernel path change. I profiled one run and the GEMM kernel selected is the int8 epilogue path with weird tiling for Ampere.

anya: attaching profiler snapshot snippet:

```
cuBLASLt Matmul: algo=INT8_EPILOGUE, tile=32x64, workspace=0
kernel: cublasLt_gemm_int8_epilog::matmul_32x64
elapsed_ms: 0.96

Previous (pre-bump):
cuBLASLt Matmul: algo=GEMM_FP16, tile=64x128, kernel=fp16_gemm_fast
elapsed_ms: 0.42
```

tobias: interesting — so autotune/autopick is preferring int8 path now. Could be a changed heuristic inside cublasLt or changed workspace/query behavior causing our selector to think int8 is better.

mohit: i ran a microbench locally with the same binary but different driver/lib stack and reproduced. When LD_PRELOAD pointing to old cublasLt it goes back to fp16 path and perf recovers.

leo: bisect plan?

anya: suspecting two suspects: (1) the system image bumped to cublasLt 2.14.0 in streak-ops merge r4821, (2) a runtime autotune tweak in PR 5202 that changed the "prefer_int8_if_workspace_zero" flag. I'll bisect both.

ci-bot: scheduled perf bisect job job-61123 (running night-run on 2 revisions: revert r4821 and revert pr5202). Will post results.

mohit: quick local binary revert of pr5202 (autotune flag) removed the int8 pick and perf returns to baseline. So that narrows to pr5202 being root cause for our runtime heuristic flip.

leo: can you paste the tiny diff in pr5202 that might cause this? I remember it simplified workspace checks.

mohit: snippet:

```
- if (workspace_size >= required) prefer_int8 = true;
+ if (workspace_size > 0) prefer_int8 = true; // accidentally made looser
```

mohit: previously we required >= required (enough workspace for the best int8 algo). this change accepts any non-zero workspace and a later cublasLt query now reports tiny workspace >0 for many tilings, so int8 chosen even when it runs slower.

anya: that explains it. cublasLt behavior on query changed post-2.14 so tiny workspace hints show up. combination of both changes produced the regression.

tobias: rollout implications: this is a blocker. if runtime picks int8 willy-nilly we degrade many customer workloads on Ampere. Need revert or guard ASAP.

leo: agreed. quick mitigation: add a conservative guard back to require workspace >= threshold and gate by model_arch + seq_len; or add env var to force disable int8 autopick: `REDWOOD_RT_FORCE_DISABLE_INT8_AUTOPICK=1`

mohit: opened revert PR 5277 that reverts the loosening and added a unit test. also added an env flag `REDWOOD_RT_INT8_ALLOW_MIN_WORKSPACE` default false. PR diff excerpt:

```
+ bool allow_min = getenv_bool("REDWOOD_RT_INT8_ALLOW_MIN_WORKSPACE", false);
+ if (!allow_min && workspace_size < required) prefer_int8 = false;
```

ci-bot: revert PR 5277 queued for CI.

perf-bot: quick canary run on staging with PR 5277 applied: throughput back to 1185 tok/s (within noise). p50 0.85ms.

anya: excellent. let's hold the control plane rollout until CI green on revert and a short canary on dedicated pools.

tobias: action items:
- @mohit leave PR 5277 up and add a short note in changelog about interactions with cublasLt queries
- @leo run canary on 3 dedicated nodes, both cuda 12 and cuda 13 images
- @anya notify infra/scheduling to hold the streak-ops system image bump until we confirm cublasLt behavior

leo: will run canary now, posting logs here.

leo: canary update: staging-dedicated-1 running for 20m, perf stable. no drop observed. rolling safe to 20% canary once CI passes :thumbsup:

anya: thanks. leaving this thread pinned to eng-runtime until rollout cleared. great triage team work :clap:

perf-bot: note: add integration test to nightly for int8-autopick combos (smallbatch+seq32) so we catch this earlier.

mohit: already on it, adding test in harness.

ci-bot: job-61123 finished: culprit = pr5202 (autotune heuristic loosening). revert PR 5277 ready.

tobias: when it's merged let's also publish a short dev note in #eng-runtime with recommended env toggles for customers on dedicated/private if they hit this in the wild.

anya: agreed. closing for now once revert merged and canary passes.
